title: After the Yasuda Kinen: Heating Up

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho puts in an incredible performance, electrifying the crowds at the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Back on the training track, Zenno Rob Roy gets even more fired up when she hears about the results of the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Who will be the protagonist of this story, the witch who has finally completed her incantation, or the newly awakened hero? We'll find out at the Takarazuka Kinen.
